card.name: Start of a split capitalized word
card.fires_on: A short capital-letter piece that begins a word and is split off from its rest, such as R, Ger or H. It appears just before the word continues, often in names, acronyms and drug-label headings.

modes.label: Ger in germline
modes.description: The piece Ger starts the word Germline in a BRCA-mutation treatment heading.
modes.example: Maintenance Treatment of Recurrent<< Ger>>mline BRCA -Mutated O

modes.label: Single capital letter
modes.description: A lone capital such as R or H starts a name or abbreviation.

modes.label: Odd mid-name pieces
modes.description: A split-off piece sits inside a title or coined word.

card.plain: It fires when a word has just been started with a single capital letter or short piece, as in Germline or HLA.
